cohort: The study included 422 healthy infants in their first year of life attending a vaccination clinic in Riyadh, excluding those with chronic illnesses, congenital defects, preterm birth, low birth weight, or below the 5th percentile in height or weight.
finding: Heavier children (adjusted for age) and those exclusively breastfed showed earlier eruption of primary teeth in their first year of life.
cross-section timing: During the first year of life when attending a vaccination clinic
birth_weight: Normal birth weight (low birth weight infants were excluded)
